 Swarm of earthquakes, including a 5.0 strike near Pinnacles 
 Multiple earthquakes struck near Pinnacles on Thursday night, according to the United States Geological Survey 
 By NBC Bay Area staff • 
 Published 41 minutes ago • 
 Updated 17 seconds ago 
 BOOKMARKER 
 Are you prepared for the next big one? 
 Multiple earthquakes hit near Pinnacles on Thursday night, according to the United States Geological Survey 
 The strongest was a 5.0 magnitude earthquake and hit at 10:40 p.m. It was centered 6.2 miles northwest of Pinnacles, according to the USGS. 
 Watch NBC Bay Area News free wherever you are
   WATCH HERE 
 According to the USGS, that earthquake was followed by two 2.5 earthquakes of magnitude 2.5, another of magnitude 3.4, then another of magnitude 2.6 and one of 2.7 magnitude.
 This is a developing story. Details may change as more information becomes available. Stay tuned for updates.
